title: List of offerings
notes: Scan supplied as AJHS_P_15_4_267.pdf (104 pages): offerings books and loose sheets of Congregation Shearith Israel, New York — quarterly returns for 5572 and 5575–5578, offerings on holy days and Sabbaths 1818–1821 kept by Aaron Levy, accounts of offerings due, and a sheet of 1804. Also in the folder: dockets, a bill from Wm. Warner for offerings, 1817–1820 (scans 59–60), and a household bill paid 11 January 1814 (scans 100–101).

title: Bound financial ledger regarding donations and subscriptions, 1838-1858
notes: Hebrew Sunday School Society of Philadelphia (Pa.) Records, Temple University Libraries, Special Collections Research Center, SCRC 50, Box 1, Folder 3; identifier JHSSMZ202010000011. 100 digital images. Catalog title retained verbatim; appended subscription/donation lists and expenditures are dated 1859. Contributions on 44 scans transcribed in full as draft readings; covers, rules, expenditure pages, blank pages and accounting-only summaries are inventoried without turning them into donor records. Dollar/cents columns converted to USD; long-s read as s. Names and honorifics remain source readings, with no inferred personal identities. Anonymous receipts and paired/joint gifts preserved; balances, interest, book sales, cancelled rows and repeated summary totals excluded from donor amounts.
